meta: Ask AI to write a review of your week and pick one habit to keep, so next week you don't slip back into old ways. Day 7, the last day of the 7-day AI…

muc.title: Day 7: looking back
muc.text: Day seven of seven, the last one: if you finish without looking back, it's easy to slip into old habits next week.

muc.title: Quickly recap the last six days
muc.text: Type out for AI which days worked, which you skipped and which task helped most. Messy is fine.

muc.title: A five-line review
muc.text: Ask AI to turn it into a five-line review: what went well, what got in the way, and what you want to try next.

muc.title: Keep just one habit
muc.text: Then choose only one habit to keep. Keeping one thing for a long time beats dropping all seven after a week.

muc.title: Day 7 task
muc.text: Ask a chatbot to turn your notes into a weekly review, then pick one habit and set a calendar reminder.
